 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Auburn basketball faces Notre Dame on Thursday in the final game of the Player's Era 8 in Las Vegas.
 After losing its opening game in Las Vegas to West Virginia, Auburn bounced back with an 86-71 win over UNLV in the Player's Era 8 consolation game on Wednesday night. Tahaad Pettiford posted another strong outing with 22 points, four rebounds, and three assists. Owen Freeman (18 points), Adam Olsen (15 points), and Bukky Oboye (14 points) followed Pettiford with strong performances of their own.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Notre Dame needed an extra period to defeat Rutgers on Wednesday. A clutch three-pointer by Braeden Smith with 1:52 remaining in overtime sparked the necessary run that the Fighting Irish needed to cruise to a 110-100 win over the Scarlet Knights. All five of Notre Dame's starters reached double figures, led by Brady Koehler's 27-point outing that included four three-point makes.

 Auburn vs. Notre Dame live updates, analysis 
 Hit refresh for the latest updates from Michelob Ultra Arena in Las Vegas as Auburn faces Notre Dame in the Player's Era 8. 
 1st half: Auburn uses 9-0 run to take the lead over Notre Dame
 05:26 PM ET, November 19 2026, Taylor Jones 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Momentum shifted to Auburn following the first media timeout. Auburn has built a 9-0 run over the last 2:40 to take a 17-14 lead over Notre Dame with 10:55 to go until halftime.
 Auburn has made 2 of its last three shots while Notre Dame has missed two straight buckets.
 1st half: Auburn is struggling from long range early
 05:21 PM ET, November 19 2026, Taylor Jones 
 Eight of Auburn's 10 field goal attempts have been from three-point range, and they have connected on just three of them.
 The Tigers missed their first three shots before Adam Olsen broke the streak with a three-pointer at the 17:04 mark in the first half. Tahaad Pettiford and Bukky Oboye join Olsen with a three-pointer of their own. Pettiford has added a jumper, and he leads with 5 points at the first media timeout.
 Auburn basketball reveals starters for its game against Notre Dame
 04:56 PM ET, November 19 2026, Taylor Jones 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Auburn head coach Steven Pearl elects to use the same starting lineup for the second game in a row.
 G Tahaad Pettiford
 G George Kimble III
 F Thomas Dowd
 F Adam Olsen
 C Narcisse Ngoy
 The lineup combined for 46 of Auburn's 86 points in its win over UNLV on Wednesday and recorded 19 rebounds and 17 assists.
 Auburn-Notre Dame to tip off on time.

 The prior game between Florida and West Virginia has wrapped up, and Auburn-Notre Dame will begin on schedule.
 Tipoff will is set for 5:06 p.m. CT.
